2609.35410.title: Spectral Super-Resolution using Spatial-Spectral Residual Operator Networks
2609.35410.paper_summary: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.
2609.35410.paper_summary_zh: 多光譜衛星影像的光譜超解析可以以適度的成本實現高時間和空間解析度的高光譜衛星影像，顯著增加高光譜遙感的適用性。這一任務本質上是病態的，這使得它非常適合基於深度學習的方法。在這項研究中，光譜超解析任務被框架為一個運算元學習問題，並提出了 SSRON 作為一個深度運算元網絡，能有效學習從降採樣光譜到連續光譜的函數對函數映射。該模型被訓練以將類似 Sentinel-2A 的多光譜影像超解析為 EMIT 影像。與基線模型相比，SSRON 在所有指標上都達到了更優的性能。該模型還顯示出零樣本光譜超解析的能力，通過預測在訓練期間未見的波段。此外，其連續輸出公式暗示了在比原始傳感器更細的波長間隔下估計光譜的潛力。這些結果表明了 SSRON 的潛力，並確立了運算元學習作為光譜超解析的一個有前景的方向。
2609.35410.author: Seokhyun Chin et.al.
